subject: [Invite] Private AI Execs Dinner - SF- Feb 26
text:
Hi [NAME],

Been following what you're building across Niantic Labs & Niantic Spatial
-  the work on LGM is really inspiring. A lot of teams talk about physical
AI being the focus for [YEAR], but few have started solving the grounding
problems.

Thought it'd be a good time to invite you to an exclusive dinner my
co-founders are hosting on *Thursday Feb 26* in SF at Michelin starred *Niku
Steakhouse*. We're bringing together ~20 founder, CxOs, and heads of AI/ML
who are actively building and deploying models - no decks, no press, just
like-minded AI practitioners chatting over nice food and drinks.

Zipline, Dyna Robotics, Pi, etc to improve training data quality and model
performance at scale.

Would love your perspective at the table - can I save you a seat?

training data nowadays - open to a quick chat?
